name: responsive-home-preview-and-listener-badges
changes: Removed rotated text/card rasterization and glass blur from public homepage preview for a sharper desktop/tablet/mobile rendering.
Centered the language and verified-profile text within compact balanced badges on listener profiles.
Moved the Donate button to the far right of the identity row on mobile while preserving the existing secure donation checkout.
Updated customer asset URLs and PWA service-worker cache version to 8.9.28.
notes: Deploy frontend and backend together. The existing Render production start command runs the additive SQL schema migration automatically.
Razorpay must be configured and permitted to process listener tips/donations. No keys are included in the frontend.
Supported one-time donation amount: ₹10 to ₹10,000; no subscription and no use of the customer talk-time balance.
